_comment: Station illustrations for S3 (docs/ART.md). One square image per Station, cropped by the screen: the card banner shows the centre band (~2.2:1), the picker tile the centre column (~0.65:1). Keep the subject in the centre.
style: Concept art illustration, interior of a cramped crewed compartment aboard a worn industrial starship, painterly digital painting in the style of gritty 1990s space-strategy concept art, muted desaturated steel-grey and dark teal palette, one strong accent light of {accent}, two or three crew in grimy work jumpsuits, cables and pipes, scuffed metal plating, low-key dramatic lighting. Compact composition: the main subject is small and centered in the middle of the frame, the room continues to every edge. No text, no logos, no UI.

shield.subject: Shield control room: crew at consoles watching a holographic bubble diagram of the ship's shield, glowing cyan emitter coils behind armoured glass.

logistics.subject: Quartermaster's bay: crew with data slates checking stacked supply crates and thick fuel lines, an inventory board glowing amber.

engine.subject: Engine room: crew at throttle consoles before a viewport onto a huge glowing orange thruster chamber, heat haze.

energy.subject: Capacitor bay: crew calibrating large beam-emitter lenses, violet energy arcs between capacitor banks.

ballistic.subject: Autoloader gallery: crew hauling heavy shells onto an ammunition conveyor that feeds a massive turret breech, yellow sparks.

missile.subject: Missile magazine: crew hand-loading missiles into tall vertical launch racks under red warning lights.

phase.subject: Phase coil chamber: crew in hooded suits around a ring of shimmering coils, the air warped and doubled, ghostly afterimages.

reactor.subject: Reactor control: crew at flux gauges before a glowing blue-white fusion core inside a containment ring.

damage_control.subject: Damage control team: crew in welding masks patching a breached bulkhead, sparks, flashing emergency lights.

flight_deck.subject: Hangar bay: one small single-seat fighter craft parked in the middle of the frame on a launch rail, deck crew refuelling it with hoses and loading a missile under its wing, signal batons, bright launch lights.
